title: St. Augustine Lady Knights Embracing Early Challenges at 5-9
excerpt: Battling injuries and illnesses to key players and tested by a tough predistrict schedule, the 5-9 St. Augustine Lady Knights are riding a three-game win streak into December, according to head coach Eduardo Valdez.
content:
The St. Augustine Lady Knights have not backed down from a challenge this season. Battling injuries and illnesses to key players while being tested by a tough predistrict slate, the 5-9 Lady Knights are in a good spot, according to head coach Eduardo Valdez, the Laredo Morning Times reported Nov. 24.

The Knights are riding a three-game win streak. Their latest win came Nov. 23, a 49-39 victory over Falfurrias built on defense, according to the Laredo Morning Times. Junior guard Alejandra Perez-Kawas credited the win to teamwork, ball movement and waiting for open shots.

Senior Mia Valdez leads the team in scoring at 5.6 points per game and in rebounding at 5.4 per game, according to MaxPreps.

The Lady Knights are 2-1 at home and have scored 525 points while allowing 707 through 14 games.

St. Augustine returns to the court Dec. 1 at Cigarroa at 6 p.m., then faces United in tournament play Dec. 3 at 11 a.m.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times — “Lady Knights embracing early challenges”, Nov. 24, 2026; MaxPreps — St. Augustine Knights girls basketball schedule, https://www.maxpreps.com/tx/laredo/st-augustine-knights/basketball/girls/schedule/
